top_signals.title: Health data of more than 9.5 million people leaked from Aesto record system
top_signals.summary: The healthcare data company Aesto informed federal regulators this week that more than 9.5 million people had sensitive information leaked during a cyberattack last December.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
